| Fact | Source/Confidence |
|------|------------------|
| A2A protocol defines `Task` states: `submitted`, `working`, `input-required`, `completed`, `failed`, `canceled` | A2A spec (high confidence) |
| HTTP 429/503 are transient retryable statuses per RFC 9110 | RFC 9110 (high confidence) |
| Idempotency keys are standard practice for POST-based task creation | REST best practice (high confidence) |
| Signed payloads require canonical serialization to be verifiable | JWS/COSE standards (high confidence) |

**Assumption (unverified):** Technocore exposes a task API compatible with A2A's `tasks/send` and `tasks/get` endpoints. This must be confirmed against actual Technocore documentation before implementation.
